method: Clusters assigned on ECONOMIC SUBSTANCE (what state variable the feature reads, what transform is applied, what sign is claimed) and then checked against the measured 6x6 Spearman rank matrix (cross_cluster_correlation.json). Not by lane, axis label or proposal text. The plan Section 1.2 rule A7-N enforces: if family X is selected, any OTHER proposal in X's cluster is ineligible even if otherwise clean.

clusters.state_variable: cross-sectional LEVEL of the trailing 28d mean perp-vs-index premium (the crowding/carry premium level) from 15m price-gap routes
clusters.transform: 28d rolling mean, ranked across 19 symbols; WIDTHGATE scales/gates the SAME ordering by the cross-sectional IQR of those levels (median split, no tuned constant)
clusters.sign_claim: fade: long low-premium tier / short high-premium tier (negative relation to forward weekly relative return); WIDTHGATE claims the same ordering works only in wide-dispersion states
clusters.why_one_cluster: IDENTICAL state variable and IDENTICAL inside book ordering; WIDTHGATE's gate is a membership/scale modifier of the PREMFADE book, not a different signal. MEASURED: pooled Spearman +0.9614 (n=988), per-fold +0.969/+0.951/+0.964 - at or above the V13 collapse level in EVERY fold

clusters.state_variable: the premium index kline path (perp-side premium rate), transformed as a FIRST DIFFERENCE
clusters.transform: standardized 72h change (30d sigma of daily-sampled 72h changes), ranked ascending, long the 5 most-negative
clusters.sign_claim: premium-overhang reversion: fresh premium collapse -> perp outperformance
clusters.why_own_cluster: flow (first-moment difference) statistic, distinct from the level state of C1 and from second-moment regimes of C3; MEASURED: pooled |rho| vs every other measurable proposal <= 0.046 (n=402 pairwise-complete)

clusters.state_variable: the premium index kline path, transformed as a SECOND MOMENT through time
clusters.transform: std(ddof=1) of consecutive 15m premium-close changes over trailing 30d, ranked ascending, long the 5 lowest
clusters.sign_claim: premium-instability unwind overhang: low premium-vol (stable funding expectations, uncrowded) outperforms
clusters.why_own_cluster_and_disclosure: substantively a distinct transform (regime second moment) from C1 (level) and C2 (first difference); A7-N can NEITHER confirm NOR refute measured cluster membership: the premium-close zero sentinel (A9F-DISC-1) leaves the fail-closed 2880-bucket window with only 12 eligible observations in the whole panel (at most 1 name per stamp, zero within-stamp cross-section), so every Spearman involving PREMVOL is mechanically undefined (zero-variance rank vector; recorded null, never fabricated). The C2-vs-C3 relationship (first vs second moment of the SAME series) is therefore empirically UNRESOLVED this cycle - flagged for A1. A9-F separately routes PREMVOL BLOCKED_DATA under the proposal's own failure table.

clusters.state_variable: the symbol's own daily open-interest path (aggregate position-book stability), excluding price entirely from the feature
clusters.transform: second moment of the DAILY path: std(ddof=1) of the 28 most recent daily log OI changes, ranked ascending, long lowest-CH tercile / short highest
clusters.sign_claim: low churn (sticky, conviction/hedge inventory) outperforms high churn (hot-money books) over the following week
clusters.why_own_cluster: OI-path second moment: a different information set (positioning, not premium/price) and a different transform from C1-C3. Measured near-orthogonal to the C1 pair (-0.373/-0.338, below the 0.70 candidate line) and to C2 (-0.044), and DISTINCT from its own lane-mate OICYC (+0.132 pooled) despite the shared AXIS-3 label - the label similarity is not a measured cluster

clusters.state_variable: the CROSS-SYMBOL co-movement structure of positioning flows (market-wide leverage cycle), excluding own-path level and price entirely from the feature
clusters.transform: OLS slope of own daily log OI change on the leave-one-out 18-symbol aggregate over 28 paired daily changes, ranked ascending, long lowest-CYC tercile / short highest
clusters.sign_claim: low cycle-beta (cycle-orthogonal positioning) outperforms high cycle-beta (cycle-chasing, correlated unwinds)
clusters.why_own_cluster: a co-moment/market-relative slope, not a dispersion: a symbol that doubles WITH the market and one that doubles AGAINST a flat market get opposite slopes but identical own-path statistics, so C5 is provably not C4's transform, and measured pooled rho(OICH, OICYC) = +0.132 (per-fold +0.132 in each fold) - far below the 0.70 candidate line

expected_same_cluster_pairs_declared_ex_.justification: same state variable and same inside book; the gate is a modifier of the same ordering
first vs second moment of the SAME premium series - related transforms with different sign claims; expected related but not necessarily same-cluster
expected_same_cluster_pairs_declared_ex_.measured_after: UNRESOLVED (PREMVOL panel degenerate, 12 obs); A1 should not treat separation as verified

expected_same_cluster_pairs_declared_ex_.justification: shared data source (staged OI) and axis label, but provably different transforms (own-path dispersion vs market-relative slope)

section_1_2_rule_application.rule: if family X is selected, any OTHER proposal in X's cluster is ineligible even if otherwise clean (plan Section 1.2)
section_1_2_rule_application.note: This is a measured cluster map, NOT a selection ranking and NOT a recommendation; which families are selected is A1's frozen-rubric decision. The only measured HARD same-cluster pair is PREMFADE|WIDTHGATE; selecting both would violate Section 1.2.
